verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents its own test-purchase capability: products created directly in RevenueCat support instant test purchases with no real money charged. That is a first-party sandbox-style testing path. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and it does not show that test data stays isolated from production customer data or charts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox environment separated from production data, how agents or MCP tools target that sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Create products directly in RevenueCat - Test purchases work instantly - No real money charged
